links.note: Two examples of the word community stretching - a jati, Mumbai's Parsi community, a school's art community - are all this concept's own list. Already linked and correct.

Why couples opt for a nuclear family turns on this concept's definitions of the two family types, the joint family's several generations against the couple and their children. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.

Dana or giving learned in the family - this concept calls the family a school where children learn ahimsa, dana, seva and tyaga, and notes that individuals often give up their own needs for the family's.
Shalini not minding her simpler dress and being happy that everyone could get some new clothes - this concept's closing lines. Already linked and correct.
The values in Kamal Parmar's initiative - this concept's own closing questions ask what attitude towards the community the story reveals and what values it reflects. Already linked and correct.
The Bhils planting thousands of trees, digging trenches and building water harvesting structures, with the objective of serving Mother Earth - this concept's account. Already linked and correct.

The teacher's remark about the children's attention despite no benches or quiet rooms, and the volunteer who said we went there to teach, instead we learnt a lot from them - this concept quotes both. Already linked and correct.
Tenzing's parents discussing special expenses together and saving for unexpected needs - this concept's closing lines. Already linked and correct.
Residents Welfare Associations as communities that make their own rules, with residents participating in making them - this concept's description. Already linked and correct.
Comparing the joint and nuclear family with an advantage and a disadvantage each rests on this concept's two definitions. Already linked and correct.

Dana and tyaga as family values, with Shalini's household as the illustration - this concept names both values and says individuals often give up their own needs for the family's. Already linked and correct.
The roles of Tenzing's father, mother, grandmother and grandfather - this concept sets out all four. Already linked and correct.

The urban half of the required pair is this concept's Ahmedabad story, which the chapter introduces precisely as the urban counterpart to the rural examples. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.
Unwritten practices on shared natural wealth - water, grazing lands, forest produce - giving secure access while requiring duties of every family. This concept's passage. Already linked and correct.
RWA rules on waste, common areas and pets, and their dependence on traders and municipal workers - this concept states both halves. Already linked and correct.
Community as a flexible concept, with jati, religion, region, common work or interest and school clubs as the different senses - this concept's list. Already linked and correct.
Tiruvalluvar's line that love and dharma are the flower and fruit of family life - this concept opens the chapter on it.

Kamal Parmar's Ahmedabad initiative, which drew in teachers and student volunteers, is the chapter's urban case of community - which is what unsettles the idea that community spirit is only rural. Already linked and correct.

Why Indian languages carry so many kinship terms - this concept's observation, that a single word in the mother tongue often needs several English words, and that the English word covering several relations does so by being vaguer.
The challenges of a joint family are weighed against this concept's definition of it, several generations living under one roof. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.
Ravi in a nuclear family and Priya in a joint family in the same city - the case turns entirely on this concept's two definitions. Already linked and correct.

An RWA organising a cleanliness drive and depending on others for final waste disposal - this concept's rules on cleanliness of common areas and its point about depending on municipal workers. Already linked and correct.
